notes: The process correctly models two-byte packing, first-byte retention, pack order, synchronous reset, backpressure stability, output transfer, and the deliberate no-replacement handshake rule. in_ready is continuously equal to !out_valid_r, so an input cannot be accepted on an edge whose pre-edge output is valid even when out_ready is high. Accepted output clears out_valid while preserving the last published out_data. The minor wording in S2.1 about using two registers does not alter the explicitly described state model. Final RTL passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
